name: Securities Lending & Prime Brokerage
description: Securities lending, borrow costs, and prime brokerage client financing.

dimensions.name: borrow_category
dimensions.description: General collateral or special (hard to borrow)

metrics.name: on_loan_value
metrics.description: Market value on loan at a point in time

metrics.name: utilization
metrics.description: Value on loan divided by lendable value

metrics.name: client_debit_balance
metrics.description: Prime client margin loans at a point in time

conventions.rule: Cash-collateralized loans pay a rebate; fee = benchmark rate minus rebate. State which is quoted.
Specials are a small share of balance but most of revenue; show GC and specials separately.

insight_rules.reason: Fees are balance-weighted; attribute through revenue by security.

caveats.text: Borrow can be recalled; availability and fees can change daily.

chart_conventions.rule: Show revenue concentration by security as a sorted bar of top names.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
